ashwin: Quick design check — compact diff row actions feel cramped when annotations appear. Trying inline annotation toolbar prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/inline-toolbar-proto. Thoughts? clare: Looks useful. Main concern: toolbar covers text on narrow screens. Also hover target is small — hard for touch. joel: If we show toolbar on selection, overlap is unavoidable. Could float above line with small caret. For touch, we should implement long-press to open toolbar. neha: Accessibility nit: ensure toolbar is reachable by keyboard (e.g., press `a` when row focused) and has aria-labels. Also contrast for icons needs AA pass. samira: Agree. Also re: affordance — users didn't notice row is selectable. Maybe add a drag-handle/checkbox affordance on hover: '⋮' or a subtle outline. ashwin: What about using a left rail affordance that appears on hover/focus? Keeps inline text clear. On mobile, we'd use a swipe gesture to reveal actions — not a long-press. clare: Swipe conflicts with scroll. Might be okay for single-line rows but bad for multi-line outputs. Maybe tap-to-select then show toolbar. joel: Implementation note: prefer not to change DOM order — put toolbar in portal so focus order stable. Example snippet: ```html
…
``` neha: Also keyboard shortcut mapping: Enter to open, Esc to close, Left/Right to move between annotations. Add focus ring visible (2px) and outline-offset. samira: :thought_balloon: Microcopy: 'Add note' vs 'Annotate' — which is clearer? Users from docs team preferred 'Annotate'. ashwin: Let's A/B copy. Also need telemetry: track `annotation_open`, `annotation_submit`, `annotation_cancel`, plus `toolbar_landed_via_touch`. clare: For compact mode, reduce icon-only buttons to 24px hit target min. Add title tooltips for screen readers. joel: One more: regression diffs — when both baseline + candidate annotations exist, show stacked badges: '2 annotations' with collapsed dropdown. Avoid overlapping badges. neha: Run an a11y swat: keyboard-only flow + VoiceOver test. I can take it if assigned. ashwin: @neha yes please. @joel can you prototype portal approach and make small CSS for focus states? @clare can you prepare microcopy options for A/B? clare: On it. I'll post microcopy options in this thread tomorrow. :raised_hands: ui-bot: Design review scheduled: Thu 10am. Link: https://figma.com/xxx. Reminder will post 1h before. samira: Thanks. small follow-up — should we add 'save draft' for long annotations? Some users write paragraphs. ashwin: Good call. Add 'Save draft' + auto-save after 5s. Track `draft_saved`.
